product.name: AI Research Agents
product.description: AI-powered autonomous agents that continuously monitor the internet for business signals, buying intent, and market opportunities relevant to B2B sales and marketing.

product.name: Lead Generation Agent
product.description: An AI-powered platform that discovers and qualifies high-intent B2B prospects by analyzing hiring trends, technology signals, and market intent.

product.name: Enrichment Agent
product.description: An AI-powered tool that automatically enhances CRM data by adding missing information and updating buying signals from multiple sources.

product.name: CRM Clean-up Agent
product.description: An AI system that organizes and cleans messy CRM databases to produce accurate and actionable customer intelligence.
